rationale: Glucose and lactate are primary fermentable substrates. Arginine provides supplementary nitrogen (6 mmol) combined with ammonium (4 mmol) to meet the 10 mmol/gDW/h biomass nitrogen demand. Remaining carbon is fermented to acetate and butyrate with H₂ and CO₂ release for NADH reoxidation. Growth rate is limited by nitrogen availability and supported by the carbon flux.
